## Summary

Describe the exact behavior changed and the owner goal it serves.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant unit/integration tests pass, or the change is documentation-only
- [ ] No credentials or secrets were committed
- [ ] Paper/alert-only and execution safety boundaries remain intact, or an explicit owner decision is linked
- [ ] Deployment and configuration impact is documented

## AI coordination

- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md`, MemeBot HQ, AI Collaboration Protocol, and Current Project State before making changes
- [ ] I checked active Notion Tasks and AI Work Log entries, recent commits, and open PRs for overlapping work
- [ ] The work was claimed in a Notion Task and AI Work Log entry before substantive implementation
- [ ] The Notion handoff contains the exact changes, goal, rationale, verification, deployment impact, risks, interaction with prior work, and next action
- [ ] Related Projects, Decisions, Knowledge Base records, Marketing records, or Growth Experiments were updated when affected
